thread:
lina: Proposal: run a 4-week micro-sprint DP cohort (6 partners) aimed at surfacing high-confidence product priorities and compliance blockers. Goal: fast learning with low ops overhead.

marco: 4 weeks ok. why 6 partners? feels tight but easier to manage. :thinking_face:

lina: 6 keeps interviews meaningful and lets us rotate engineers into office hours. structure: week0 intake + dataset/sample upload, weeks1-3 active, ongoing office hours twice/week.

tasha: intake asking for sample inputs is smart. we should require a 1-page threat/data flow diagram for any partner sending PII. reduces surprises.

ben: acceptance criteria suggestion: 1) 2 concrete product use-cases, 2) sample dataset (or synthetic replica), 3) contact + engineering owner, 4) agreement to short SDK instrumentation.

lina: incentives: $500 credits + roadmap influence call (cohort advisory) + early case study (optional). keep it simple.

marco: feedback channels: weekly 10-min async pulse (3 fields), one office hours slot split into product/infra, and a final 45m debrief. no daily slack channel. we'll use a single pinned thread for questions.

tasha: evals: focus on hallucination rate on task-specific prompts, 95th percentile latency, and median tokens/session. also capture a qualitative "ease" score from partner.

ben: agree. define hallucination rate = proportion of responses that fail factual-check heuristics per our eval harness. we'll need sample ground-truth for some tasks.

lina: onboarding flow: invite -> intake form -> NDA (one-pager) -> dataset upload (if applicable) -> instrumentation key. Marco to own onboarding automation.

marco: I can build the form + minimal automation to create records in Google Sheets and call a webhook to our telemetry pipeline. will add cohort_id and partner_tag on session events.

lina: telemetry schema (light): cohort_id, partner_id, session_ts, tokens_in, tokens_out, latency_ms_p50, latency_ms_p95, hallucination_flag, evaluation_pass.

ben: legal risk: partners who need dedicated/private deployments will require a longer onboarding path. add a question early: "Requires dedicated/private deployment? yes/no". route yes -> enterprise lane.

legal-bot: Recommended: use the "cohort-express-nonprod" NDA template for micro-sprints. Legal pre-approved for non-prod data with explicit consent.

marco: invite template draft (pls copy/edit):
```
Hi <partner>,
Were running a 4-week Design Partner micro-sprint (6 teams) to help prioritize features for Redwood. Youll get $500 credits, early access to new infra settings, and a recorded roadmap session. If interested, please fill this 4-question intake and sign our short cohort NDA.
```

lina: add note to template: "If you handle customer data, please upload a synthetic sample or the data schema."

tasha: success metrics proposal:
- Recruitment: fill cohort within 10 days of invites for first two cohorts
- Compliance: 0 unresolved legal/data blockers at end of intake for 80% of partners
- Signals: surface at least 4 feature asks with cross-partner support (>=2 partners each)
- Quality: hallucination rate improvement or parity when running our recommended config (no >3% regression allowed)
- Performance: no more than 10% increase in p95 latency for recommended optimizations vs baseline

ben: gating rule: if >=2 partners report data-handling blockers that are unresolved after intake week, pause new cohort invites and escalate.

marco: ops timeline: cohort-0 (internal staff trial) 2025-10-18, cohort-1 invites 2025-10-27, cohort-1 onboarding starts 2025-11-03.

lina: owners: marco -> invite + onboarding automation, tasha -> eval harness & prompt sets, ben -> compliance path + intake checklist, lina -> cohort selection & partner comms.

marco: quick infra note: I'll add a feature flag on runtime to tag events with cohort_id; we'll keep telemetry sampling at 1:1 for partners during the sprint to avoid skew.

lina: operational items this week: invite copy, intake form, NDA draft, eval pack for one vertical, telemetry webhook. Owners acknowledged above.

tasha: will deliver vertical eval pack (customer support summarization) + scoring rubric by Thu EOD.

ben: I'll prep the intake checklist and compliance routing doc by Fri.

lina: ping legal for NDA sign-off; if legal-bot approves, we'll proceed. check-in here Fri afternoon.

legal-bot: Noted. Filing a ticket for express NDA review; target response 48 hours.

marco: deployed automation draft ready; will post link to sheet in thread when done.

lina: thanks all. If anyone wants to join the staff trial, DM me. :rocket:
_metadata_note: No title field included per agents.md. Messages are chronological and prefixed by sender. All fields are strings or list of strings.
